label: Classical attributes field of the case signature
definition: Given the Catholicism case signature σ and a being g, σ.HasClassicalAttributes g is the signature’s primitive predicate for the full classical attribute field at g.
note: The case signature supplies the predicate on its being carrier. The separately stated ClassicalAttributesSuffice maps a concrete nine-predicate bundle to this field. The field has no definitional eliminator into individual attributes. Its application and the interpretation of the sufficiency map remain open.

formal_gap.meaning: For a supplied case signature and a being on its carrier, the field is intended to ascribe the classical attributes collectively to that being. Each attribute in the separately supplied nine-predicate sufficiency condition is evaluated at that same being.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: An actual application would require the metaphysical and naming premises under investigation. ClassicalAttributesJointWitness and NecessaryClassicalGodRootControl provide interpretations of the field on formal carriers.
exclusions: The field differs from the signature’s GOD_4 predicate and from the explicit conjunction NineClassicalAttributes. Its Lean declaration gives no eliminator into a particular attribute.
open_obligations: The nine-to-field implication and any stronger interpretation or converse require separate warrant.
